steps_raw.instruction: ELISA IL-1β (DuoSet – R&D Systems, Minneapolis, MN, EUA) 1. Add 100L of capture antibody (Work concentration= 4g/mL) in 96-well plate. To reach the work concentration, dilute 50L from the capture antibody aliquot at the concentration of 800g/mL (with 40g) in 10mL of Carbonate-Bicarbonate Buffer to obtain a concentration of 4g/mL. 2. Incubate the plate overnight in a wet chamber at 4ºC 3. Wash the plate 3x with PBS-T (250L/well) 4. Block with 200L of PBS-T 5% skimmed milk powder 5. Incubate 3h at room temperature 6. Wash the plate 3x with PBS-T 7. To prepare the curve, dilute 25L from the recombinant aliquot (2500pg/mL) in 225L of Reagent Diluent (RD) 1% BSA-PBS to obtain the concentration of 250pg/mL First point of the curve: 250pg/mL. Add 100L of IL-1 Rec on the 1st and 2nd well. Add 100L of RD 1% BSA-PBS on 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th, 6th, 7th and 8th well. Serial dilution from the 2nd well to the last well. 8. Add 100L of samples 9. Incubate for 3h at room temperature 10. Wash the plate 3x with PBS-T 11. Add 100L of detection antibody (Work concentration =200ng/mL) To reach the work concentration, dilute 50L from the detection antibody aliquot at the concentration of 40g/mL (with 2g) in 10mL of RD to obtain a concentration of 200ng/mL 12. Incubate for 2h at room temperature 13. Wash the plate 3x with PBS-T 14. Add 100L of Streptavidin 1:200 15. Incubate in dark chamber for 30 minutes at room temperature 16. Wash the plate 3x with PBS-T 17. Add 100L of substrate 1 tablet of OPD (SigmaFast OPD, Sigma, Life Science, EUA) + 1 buffer + 20L of distilled water  to do 2 plates 18. Incubate in dark chamber for 20 minutes at room temperature 19. Block with 50L of H2SO4 2N 20. Epoch reading at 492 nm (Test-dependent wavelength)( Epoch-BioTek, Winooski, VT, EUA)
